subject.title: PR5/5 durable core: internal session delivery handoff

question: Should a durable wake be allowed to cross a user-initiated session reset, or must delivery be fenced to the session generation resolved when the wake is queued?
rationale: The current implementation appears to inherit generic `systemEvent` cross-reset behavior, but durable wakes contain state from a prior run; whether that state may enter a replacement conversation is a session-lifecycle product decision.

options.title: Fence session generation
options.body: Persist the resolved session ID or equivalent generation token and suppress or reclassify delivery when the canonical key now points to another session.

options.title: Allow cross-reset delivery
options.body: Retain canonical-key delivery only with explicit documented semantics and proof that carrying prior durable state into a replacement conversation is intentional.

recommendation.title: Fence session generation
recommendation.body: Persist the resolved session ID or equivalent generation token and suppress or reclassify delivery when the canonical key now points to another session.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses Gateway, persisted session-state, and product recovery semantics rather than remaining a narrow durable helper choice.
